text:
**Deforestation cannot be confirmed** from the available evidence. The asset experienced approximately 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021, equivalent to 2.23% of its area.

Most of the affected area—68.1 hectares—was mapped as planted forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting or other stand replacement and does not by itself establish deforestation or land-use change. The cause and legality of the loss are also unknown.
